verdict.rationale: Fly.io offers secrets management (fly-io-docs-23), org-wide service connections without manual token-pasting (fly-io-docs-11, fly-io-docs-12, fly-io-docs-13), and its own Managed Postgres (fly-io-docs-19), which reduce some credential-wiring boilerplate. However, these are infrastructure-level networking/secrets primitives rather than native code-level bindings/SDKs for external databases, third-party APIs, or storage services akin to Workers-style bindings. Missing for 10: explicit SDK/binding integrations for common third-party services (e.g., S3, Stripe, external APIs), documentation showing reduced application code boilerplate, and independent corroboration that this actually simplifies service wiring in practice.
